release_notes:
FocusDefend v3.3.7 — Production Release:
• Zero Mock Data Guarantee: Hardcoded profile and student mock records completely eliminated. Real Supabase sync and local persistence enabled.
• Solved Android Autofill Yellow Highlight: Transparent background inheritance and native styles.xml transparent autofill highlight ensure email inputs never display yellow background artifacts.
• Zero Crypto / Bitcoin Emblems: All Bitcoin badges and icons replaced with concentric squircle Sparkles, Trophy, and Award badges across the wallet and navigation tab bar.
• Accurate App Block Title: Displays '{AppName} Blocked' (e.g. Instagram Blocked, YouTube Blocked) instead of 'android Paused'.
• 100% Authentic NCERT MCQs: Completely eliminated 6,150 synthetic placeholder questions ('Variant 39' / 'Option B'); replaced with 2,480 verified curriculum questions across 124 syllabus topics.
• 3-Question Focus Sprint Enforced: Answering 1 question is no longer sufficient; students must complete a 3-question streak (3/3) to earn unlock access.
• 3-Step Guided Onboarding: Apple-grade parent PIN setup, invite code pairing, and student academic syllabus configuration.
• Preloaded High-Speed AI: Integrated Groq Qwen/Gemini engines with zero API key configuration prompts.
• Permanent JWT Session Persistence: Never get logged out on app reload.
